[FACT] User finds the estimated monthly payment of $1,664 a bit higher than expected.  
[USER] User asks for more information about different types of mortgage insurance and how they affect monthly payments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mortgage insurance (MI) protects the lender if the borrower defaults on the loan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Two primary types of mortgage insurance: Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) and Federal Housing Administration (FHA) Mortgage Insurance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] PMI is required for conventional loans with a down payment of less than 20%.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] PMI premium might range from 0.3% to 1.5% of the original loan amount annually.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For a $350,000 loan with a 10% down payment, PMI could add approximately $87.50 to $437.50 per month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] FHA loans require both an upfront mortgage insurance premium (MIP) and an annual MIP.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Upfront MIP for a $350,000 loan with a 3.5% down payment would be $6,125.
